meta.title: Inter-session flow
meta.description: Bind existing sessions into draggable flow nodes and draw one-way or two-way connections.

title: Inter-session flow
runModeHint: Choose a start node, enter input, and run the flow
noNodes: No nodes yet. Pick an existing session on the left.
wireHint: Wire mode: click a source node, then a target node.
duplicateSession: That session is already in the flow.
duplicateEdge: A connection already exists between these nodes.
selfEdge: A node cannot connect to itself.
positionHint: In node mode, drag nodes and click one to edit it.
noSelection: Select a node or connection to inspect it.
startNodeHint: Defaults to a root node with no incoming edge
runInputHint: Message sent to the start node
nodePromptHint: Supports {{input-x}}; empty sends the previous output as-is
edgeInstructionHint: Use {{input-x}} for the upstream output, e.g. add 5 to {{input-x}}
duplicateInputWarning: Both the edge instruction and the target node prompt use {{input-x}}; the upstream output will be inserted twice.
lineTypeHint: Pick a type first, then click source and target
defaultOutputHint: A result target overrides this; otherwise output goes here
portInUse: This port is still connected; delete its edges first.
wireNeedOutput: In wire mode, click an output port first.
